sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO UPPER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: SHORT WAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY LIFTING NEWD THROUGH CNTRL MT WILL TURN EWD TODAY...CRESTING MEAN RIDGE AXIS NEAR OR JUST N OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER. ASSOCIATED SURFACE LOW OVER SERN MT WILL CONCURRENTLY DEVELOP NEWD INTO CNTRL ND BY AFTERNOON AS WARM FRONT GRADUALLY LIFTS NWD THROUGH THE RED RIVER VALLEY. AT THE SAME TIME...A COLD FRONT ATTENDING A VORTICITY MAXIMUM MOVING ACROSS ONTARIO WILL SETTLE SWD THROUGH NRN PARTS OF ND/MN...EVENTUALLY MERGING WITH THE WARM/STATIONARY FRONT. ELEVATED TSTMS ARE ONGOING THIS MORNING FROM PARTS OF NERN MT INTO NRN ND...DRIVEN BY DCVA IN ADVANCE OF SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND ENHANCED ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL WAA. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER EPISODE LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT MAY EITHER EVOLVE FROM THESE ONGOING ELEVATED STORMS OR FROM A SEPARATE AREA OF STORM FORMATION INVOF ABOVE-MENTIONED SURFACE BOUNDARIES. IN EITHER CASE...12Z BIS/ABR/MSP SOUNDINGS SHOW VOLATILE WARM SECTOR IN PLACE WITH MUCAPE OF 6000-7000+ J/KG WHICH WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF INTENSE SUPERCELLS GIVEN 35-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE INITIAL HAZARDS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR CORRIDORS OF ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE AS STORMS GROW UPSCALE

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES INTO NEW ENGLAND TONIGHT
sections.text: POTENT VORTICITY MAXIMUM AND ASSOCIATED 50+ KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK OVER W-CNTRL MANITOBA WILL TRANSLATE RAPIDLY SEWD THROUGH ONTARIO INTO QUEBEC BY TONIGHT. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE MIDLEVEL SYSTEM COUPLED WITH FRONTAL UPLIFT ARE EXPECTED TO FOSTER AN INCREASING NUMBER OF TSTMS TODAY ACROSS ONTARIO AND QUEBEC WITH ACTIVITY MOVING/DEVELOPING SEWD INTO THE REGION TONIGHT. THE ESEWD ADVECTION OF AN ELEVATED-MIXED LAYER ATOP AN INCREASINGLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION ACROSS PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR...SUSTAINING MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OR BANDS OF TSTMS INTO PORTIONS OF UPSTATE NY AND NRN NEW ENGLAND LATE TONIGHT INTO MONDAY MORNING...SOME OF WHICH WILL BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS. ..MEAD/GARNER.. 07/17/2011

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/UPPER MS VALLEY THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A REMNANT CLUSTER OF STORMS FROM EARLY THIS MORNING HAS RECENTLY SHOWN SIGNS OF INTENSIFICATION NEAR MINOT ND. THIS CLUSTER IS ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS NE MT/NW ND...AROUND THE NW PERIPHERY OF THE CENTRAL PLAINS MIDLEVEL HIGH. AT THE SURFACE...A REMNANT BOUNDARY PERSISTS FROM CENTRAL/ERN ND INTO NRN MN...WHILE A REINFORCING FRONTAL SURGE IS MOVING SEWD INTO NE ND/NW MN IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SEPARATE SHORTWAVE TROUGH APPROACHING NW ONTARIO. VERY RICH MOISTURE /BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 75-80 F/ IS PRESENT ALONG AND S OF THIS BOUNDARY...WHERE ADDITIONAL DAYTIME HEATING WILL COMBINE WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES TO RESULT IN EXTREME INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON /MLCAPE OF 5000-6000 J PER KG/ AND A WEAKENING CAP. THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTS INTENSIFICATION OF THE ONGOING STORMS IN ND...WITH THE EXTREME INSTABILITY AND 50+ KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FAVORABLE FOR EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL. UPSCALE GROWTH OF THE CLUSTER APPEARS PROBABLE INTO THE AFTERNOON...WHEN COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT AND FORWARD PROPAGATION ALONG THE SURFACE BOUNDARY COULD LEAD TO BOW ECHO FORMATION WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR WIDESPREAD/SIGNIFICANT WIND DAMAGE. THERE WILL

sections.title: NRN MT THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE LINGERS ACROSS MT IN THE POST-FRONTAL ENVIRONMENT...WITH THE RICHER MOISTURE CONFINED TO E/SE MT IN A WEAK NELY UPSLOPE REGIME. ALOFT...GRADUAL WARMING AND HEIGHT RISES ARE EXPECTED OVER MT TODAY AS THE CENTRAL PLAINS UPPER HIGH EXPANDS...AND THERE ARE NO CLEAR EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA TO ENHANCE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IN THE WAKE OF THE SPEED MAX EXITING NE MT. STILL...IF STORMS DO FORM ACROSS NE MT NEAR THE INSTABILITY AXIS...OR ACROSS NW MT INVOF THE HIGHER TERRAIN...THERE WILL BE A RISK FOR SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: NRN NEW ENGLAND/NY TONIGHT
sections.text: A PRONOUNCED SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW APPROACHING NW ONTARIO WILL CONTINUE ESEWD ACROSS QUEBEC OVERNIGHT WITH AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE COLD FRONT. DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED IN ADVANCE OF THE FRONT AS THE NERN EXTENSION OF THE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST/UPPER GREAT LAKES SPREADS EWD OVER ONTARIO/QUEBEC AND THE SAINT LAWRENCE VALLEY. TIMING OF THE SYSTEM SUGGESTS THAT THE MORE INTENSE STORMS SHOULD REMAIN N OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...THOUGH THERE WILL BE SOME RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS OVERNIGHT FROM NRN NY INTO NRN NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: E FL THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: THE LOW PRESSURE AREA AND ASSOCIATED DEEP CONVECTION POSE SOME RISK FOR TROPICAL CYCLONE DEVELOPMENT JUST N OF THE BAHAMAS /SEE LATEST NHC FORECASTS FOR DETAILS/. THIS SYSTEM SHOULD ONLY DRIFT SWD...WITH ANY APPRECIABLE RISK FOR EMBEDDED ROTATING STORMS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WELL OFF THE ATLANTIC COAST OF FL THROUGH THE PERIOD. ..THOMPSON/LEITMAN.. 07/17/2011

sections.title: ERN ND/NERN SD...UPPER MS VALLEY TO UPPER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED AN APPARENT SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKING ESEWD INTO NWRN WI...WITH A 50 KT WLY MIDLEVEL JET EXTENDING FROM ND INTO NRN ONTARIO/LAKE SUPERIOR ATTENDANT TO A SECOND MIDLEVEL SYSTEM MOVING THROUGH NRN ONTARIO. LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING SURFACE ANALYSES SHOWED AN AREA OF LOWER PRESSURE LOCATED OVER CENTRAL SD WITH A FRONT EXTENDING EWD THROUGH CENTRAL MN...NRN WI..FAR NRN LOWER MI...TO CENTRAL ONTARIO. RICH MOISTURE RESIDES ALONG AND S OF THIS BOUNDARY FROM THE ERN DAKOTAS TO WI WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 70S TO AROUND 80 F. THIS MOISTURE COUPLED WITH A PLUME OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /7.5-8 C PER KM/ EXTENDING FROM SD TO WI WILL MAINTAIN A RESERVOIR OF MODERATE TO VERY STRONG INSTABILITY THROUGH THIS FORECAST PERIOD. A STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ INTO ERN SD/SRN MN THIS EVENING/TONIGHT WITHIN THE ENTRANCE REGION OF THE AFOREMENTIONED WLY MIDLEVEL JET WILL RESULT IN A WAA REGIME INVOF THE W-E ORIENTED SURFACE FRONT. VERY STRONG INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AROUND 50 KT WILL MAINTAIN A THREAT FOR AN ISOLATED TORNADO AND VERY LARGE HAIL YET THIS EVENING ACROSS SERN ND INTO ADJACENT WEST CENTRAL MN. OTHERWISE...AN INCREASE IN ADDITIONAL CONVECTION

sections.title: NRN NY TO NRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: THE ERN EXTENT OF A STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME WILL AID IN MAINTAINING AT LEAST MARGINAL INSTABILITY AFTER DARK ACROSS NRN NY TO NRN NEW ENGLAND. AN ONGOING FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS...CURRENTLY MOVING ESEWD ACROSS FAR SRN QUEBEC INTO FAR NRN NY...IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS INTO THE REST OF THIS DISCUSSION AREA WITH DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THE PRIMARY THREATS. MODELS SUGGEST ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY REACH NRN NY TOWARD 12Z AS AN UPSTREAM COLD FRONT APPROACHES THIS REGION. ..PETERS.. 07/18/2011
